This reference maps the frozen v1 API surfaces to the accepted SCGSim 2.0
implementation. Human accepted candidate
`a932a173edb5c56ae14740ff5177190996255bdd` (tree
`2745321736e53e2a4fe8d150f2e9d8bd176669db`) on 2026-10-09. Its semantic
state is `ACCEPTED`, not `STABILIZED`; delivery remains separate. The migration
baseline is `develop@3a52fb1`, tree
`96adcf8672b497a29dd0a6b43043cca11efc3043`. Isolated wheel observations are
specific to their frozen package and runtime-source identities; they do not
establish a user installation or transfer native results to another wheel.

Package-level facades remain the supported high-level entrypoints. The move
does not add compatibility wrappers for old internal paths. Existing consumer
pins remain unchanged; a consumer migrates only when it deliberately adopts
the v2 package and the corresponding old-to-new map.

## Migration rules

- Keep `scgsim.geometry`, `scgsim.palace`, `scgsim.aedt`, and
  `scgsim.visualization` as package entrypoints; keep `scgsim.geometry.compiler`
  as the explicit advanced compiler surface.
- Treat documented facades and declared exports as public. A private or
  importable implementation module is not automatically a supported API.
- Move each supported symbol to its single responsibility owner and re-export
  the approved high-level symbols from the package facade. Do not leave a
  second old implementation or compatibility wrapper reachable.
- Do not revive Q3D input-v1 or input-v2. Body-backed input-v3 is the accepted
  Q3D contract. The accepted candidate has an observed native build-only
  operation; that observation does not constitute a completed C/G solve or
  matrix result.
- Preserve the formal `python -m scgsim.aedt.run` command as the AEDT
  transaction entrypoint. It is a supported CLI, not a legacy wrapper.
- The v2 AEDT producer emits `scgsim.aedt.runtime-source.v13`. Its manifest
  declares 61 canonical module paths, including 41 AEDT modules, and records
  `schema_version`, `stage`, `modules`, `content_sha256`, and
  `revision_observation`; declared module bytes and digest are required, while
  the truthful Git observation may be unavailable. V13 adds no helper-hash
  map. Its declared files are not a transitive dependency attestation.
  Historical runtime-source v1–v12 retain their exact paths and identity rules;
  migration does not rewrite or reinterpret historical receipts.

## Geometry and compiler API

The migration divides the baseline `scgsim.sgb` facade into two deliberate
surfaces. `scgsim.geometry` owns source-facing planning, snapshots, normalized
input records, adapters, stack/vacuum/curve preparation and detached summaries.
`scgsim.geometry.compiler` is the advanced build surface for stage
orchestration, derived records and validators. Source-facing exports and
advanced compiler exports remain separate. The following complete inventories
record the baseline facade and submodule export sets, including model and
pipeline-only validator surfaces. Repeated
names mark a baseline symbol exported by more than one declared surface. Each
has one current definition, without an old-path compatibility wrapper.

`validate_geometry_input` is the one input-only validator: its definition
moves to `scgsim.geometry.source.validation`, below compiler orchestration,
and `scgsim.geometry.compiler.validate_geometry_input` re-exports it. Other
stage validators remain in the compiler validation owner. Shared polygon,
spatial and Entity primitives sit below source and compiler; source code does
not import planning/compiler. Source identity, snapshot detachment, caller-owned
final Net membership, native correspondence, stock CAD shell repair, curved
arrangement and XAO/physical-group behavior remain owned by their current
responsibilities.

The new responsibility tree follows the existing boundaries:

- `aedt.specs` owns common, HFSS, Q2D and Q3D-v3 request records plus explicit
  family parsing. Q3D input-v1/v2 is not restored.
- `aedt.preparation` owns portable handoff creation, source-backed geometry
  preparation and canonical cohort membership.
- `aedt.runtime.transaction` is the sole Desktop owner and receipt-state
  coordinator. Family runtimes own their native prepare/solve/export/readback;
  the narrow shared native helper owns neither a family nor Desktop.
- `aedt.epr` owns EPR models, source geometry, fields/cache and workflow.
  `aedt.results` owns strict handoff/result resolution, historical provenance,
  convergence, matrices and sealed EPR readers. Results do not start a solve.
- `aedt.presentation` owns display-only projections and plotting, with lazy
  imports kept out of strict result resolution.

`EigenmodeSim` stays the high-level mutable state owner for geometry/stack,
EPR settings, preparation and handoff invalidation. Preparation helpers do not
take over that state. Transaction ordering remains explicit: validate the
request and input cohort, write the running receipt before PyAEDT/Desktop,
perform one family transaction, persist returned facts before Desktop release,
then seal any saved EPR result. A prior native/family error remains primary if
release also fails; resolution validates returned artifacts without executing
AEDT. No shared Simulation base or common physical-result model is introduced.

The documented direct module surfaces migrate as follows: `spec` to
`specs.common/hfss/q2d/q3d/parse`; `handoff` splits among
`preparation.handoff`, `preparation.geometry` and `epr.workflow`;
`eigenmode` remains the state-owning facade; `resolve` moves to
`results.resolve`; and `run.main` remains at `scgsim.aedt.run` as a thin
delegate. The importable but non-exported `aedt.util` moves to an internal
I/O leaf and is not kept as a wrapper. EPR analysis, result readers, and
presentation modules move to their named owners above and in the responsibility
tree without expanding the package facade.

Keep `python -m scgsim.aedt.run`, its `main(argv)` and `__main__` behavior.
Generated handoff and EPR scripts continue to call that command with their
existing arguments. Transaction implementation moves behind the CLI shim.
Dynamic EPR workflow imports call the one transaction owner; EPR's HFSS
export/readback dependency becomes an explicit internal service. Visualization
imports current PyAEDT constants from the canonical spec owner without making
them public exports.

The current producer uses runtime-source v13; its declared inventory and
content digest identify the measured modules for that source snapshot, without
making the digest a permanent code value or claiming exhaustive transitive
coverage. Historical v1–v12 readers retain their original path, hash, revision
and schema meanings. Do not map old module strings onto new paths while
resolving old receipts. Handoff and receipt histories remain separate from Q3D
request versioning; Q3D remains v3 only. This map does not claim native Q3D
completion.

## Palace package symbols

`scgsim.palace` retains its current 25 package-facade names. The inventory
groups those exports by their v2 responsibility owner.


- **Current owner and responsibility:** `scgsim.palace.preparation`; keep separate mutable preparation state owners. **Facade exports:** `ElectrostaticSim`, `EigenmodeSim`.
- **Current owner and responsibility:** `scgsim.palace.results`; custody-aware result loading. **Facade exports:** `PalaceCost`, `PalacePerformance`, `PalaceProvenance`, `PalaceReturnedReceipt`, `ParsedTable`, `ResolvedPalaceResult`, `resolve_palace_result`.
- **Current owner and responsibility:** `scgsim.palace.results`; detached EPR values and offline reanalysis. **Facade exports:** `PalaceEprResult`, `epr_result`, `reanalyze_epr`, `resolve_epr_result`.
- **Current owner and responsibility:** `scgsim.palace.presentation`; solver-specific plot over detached EPR. **Facade exports:** `show_epr`.
- **Current owner and responsibility:** `scgsim.palace.results.report_data`; detached data records consumed by Palace presentation. **Facade exports:** `PalaceFailureDiagnosis`, `PalaceResultSelection`, `PassCostRecord`, `SurfaceMaskEprRecord`, `SurfaceMaskEprSeriesSnapshot`.
- **Current owner and responsibility:** `scgsim.palace.presentation.reports`; trust, physics and benchmark views over retained result evidence. **Facade exports:** `PalaceTrustReport`, `PhysicsQuantitiesReport`, `SimulationBenchmarkReport`, `inspect_run_trustworthiness`.
- **Current owner and responsibility:** `scgsim.palace.mesh.quality`; offline file reader, separate from mesh construction and solver execution. **Facade exports:** `MeshQualityReport`, `check_mesh_quality`.


## Palace direct submodule exports

These non-underscored modules declare their own `__all__` and therefore need
explicit migration entries in addition to the package facade.


- **Baseline direct import `scgsim.palace.electrostatic` → current source candidate `scgsim.palace.preparation.electrostatic`.** Declared symbols: `ElectrostaticSim`.
- **Baseline direct import `scgsim.palace.eigenmode` → current source candidate `scgsim.palace.preparation.eigenmode`.** Declared symbols: `EigenmodeSim`.
- **Baseline direct import `scgsim.palace.handoff` → current source candidate `scgsim.palace.execution.handoff`.** Declared symbols: `HandoffPlan`, `HandoffProfile`, `prepare_handoff`.
- **Baseline direct import `scgsim.palace.resolve` → current source candidate `scgsim.palace.results.resolve`.** Declared symbols: `PalaceCost`, `PalacePerformance`, `PalaceProvenance`, `PalaceReturnedReceipt`, `ParsedTable`, `ResolvedPalaceResult`, `resolve_palace_result`.
- **Baseline direct import `scgsim.palace.report`.** Declared symbols: `AmrPassSnapshot`, `PalaceFailureDiagnosis`, `PalaceResultSelection`, `PalaceTrustReport`, `PassCostRecord`, `PhysicsQuantitiesReport`, `inspect_run_trustworthiness`. Current source candidate: `scgsim.palace.presentation.reports` retains this direct export list; data records are defined in `scgsim.palace.results.report_data`. The package facade retains the other report exports, including `SimulationBenchmarkReport` and surface-mask records.


The current `scgsim.palace.results.report_data` direct module exports
`AmrPassSnapshot`, `PalaceFailureDiagnosis`, `PalaceResultSelection`,
`PassCostRecord`, `SurfaceEprRecord`, `SurfaceEprSeriesSnapshot`,
`SurfaceMaskEprRecord`, and `SurfaceMaskEprSeriesSnapshot`. The
`scgsim.palace.presentation.reports` module retains the seven direct exports
listed above.

`scgsim.palace._epr_results` and `scgsim._mesh_quality` are baseline private
implementation paths whose supported names are re-exported by `scgsim.palace`.
Their current owners are `scgsim.palace.results` and
`scgsim.palace.mesh.quality`, respectively; the old private import paths are
not compatibility surfaces.

## Visualization symbols


- **`GeometryPreview`, `GeometryPreviewArtifact` → `scgsim.visualization.preview`.** Responsibility: Source-bound preview object and returned artifact/unavailable mode.
- **`inspect_palace_geometry` → `scgsim.visualization.loaders.palace`.** Responsibility: Read the Palace mesh, manifest, index map and config into semantic preview modes.
- **`inspect_aedt_geometry` → `scgsim.visualization.loaders.aedt`.** Responsibility: Bind AEDT native/receipt identity and load solver-assigned geometry.
- **Scene records and shared rendering → `scgsim.visualization.scene`, `scgsim.visualization.rendering`.** Responsibility: Keep scene construction and rendering reusable without taking solver physics or simulation status ownership.
- **Shared loader file-identity helpers → `scgsim.visualization.loaders._common`.** Responsibility: One loader-level implementation for JSON, hash and confined-path observations.


The `scgsim.visualization` package facade continues to export exactly
`GeometryPreview`, `GeometryPreviewArtifact`, `inspect_aedt_geometry`, and
`inspect_palace_geometry`. Preview files and their manifest remain separate
from solver and handoff identity. Palace previews retain high-order cell
connectivity and node coordinates; source curves and native curved-arrangement
facts remain in the mesh manifest and detached mesh summary. These facts are
not discarded during relocation.

## Shared presentation

The baseline `scgsim._notebook_presentation` module contains physics-neutral
formatting helpers used by geometry and AEDT. Its current implementation is
`scgsim.presentation.notebook`. The formatting helpers do not own Palace or
AEDT projections, calculations, or result status; their presentation remains
solver-specific. Moving this private helper does not make its function names a
new public API.

## Accepted scope and evidence status

The baseline facade exports and documented direct submodule surfaces for
geometry/compiler, AEDT, Palace and visualization are mapped to their accepted
source owners above. Six earlier full native-to-Resolve-to-Report observations
are bound to the earlier wheel with SHA256
`48963671d4f854c185b8f95f3cd8000960355a7c48550b9ccf19b739b49f8df3` and
runtime-source v13 content digest
`42b48f3d5946fadb1e93e92a1d3eb2a55f72ff00fc41aeccf71c0fded5919fa1`; those
observations cover CPW Modal and Terminal, Q2D, Q3D AC/RL, SimplePad Q3D C/G,
and Palace ES, and are not current-wheel execution evidence. The accepted
frozen `2.0.0.dev1` candidate wheel with SHA256
`e0ab1117aad4e5578ec98251732d33f6faa2fe7524dd70dcbc44891ed024824d` has a
separate Q3D build-only/readback/save/release observation and geometry preview,
without `Analyze`, solve, or C/G matrices.

The deferred full endpoints are Xmon Palace Eigenmode Route A, CircularPad
Palace Eigenmode Route B, and HFSS Eigenmode saved-field EPR/offline loss.
Their earlier preparation or partial-native evidence remains incomplete for
those full operations; deferral does not describe them as failed. The accepted
candidate is not yet integrated, and existing consumer pins remain unchanged.
Q3D input-v1/v2 readers remain absent.
